summary_oneline: Domain Experts as declarative bundles: reuse the skills bundle/tenancy loader, the FEAT-321 identity layer, BotConfig/AgentRegistry discovery, the ADR decision plane and L2 retrieval; new surface is the manifest, the KnowledgeResolver and a stage/gate binding on FlowDefinition + ApprovalGate.

localization.role: name-keyed layer stack; `identity` is one replaceable slot (add/replace by name, from_system_prompt precedent); KNOWLEDGE_LAYER is the slot for a rendered KnowledgeContext
layer primitive with priority (IDENTITY=10, CUSTOM=80), phase, cacheable and the FEAT-707 `literal` flag for untrusted authored text
approved file-based persona precedent: five per-field Markdown files, pristine builder clone, mtime hot reload; identity_dir derived from the class module
the identity file contract (role, goal, capabilities, backstory, rationale)
existing declarative agent manifest (tools, toolkits, model, prompt layers, tags, policies, kind) loaded from YAML — the sibling/base for an expert manifest
directory-discovered YAML manifests under AGENTS_DIR/agents; duplicates warn unless replace=True; YAML can add/remove/customize prompt layers; tag index for visible-but-inert experts
workspace root for per-agent assets (prompts/, queries/, kb/, skills/, templates/, flows/) — the precedent location for a workspace expert bundle
closest bundle precedent: discovers {dir}/{name}.md and {dir}/{name}/SKILL.md, warns and skips malformed entries
frontmatter-validated Pydantic definition with token_count, assets_dir, global_only
workspace-over-package shadowing with global_only locks and reserved dir names (kb, documents, prompts, flows)
current KB path: priority-sorted retrieval list activated per question by KBSelector; no ordering layers, budget or revision
LLM-based KB chooser only (not a loader); dormant for 180 days
ADR record: source_status {proposed, accepted, superseded, …} separate from review_status; evidence hashed by source_sha1; no tags field
LLM-free, token-budgeted ADR reads (budget_tokens) — the `source: adr` consumer target
lazy shim: agent-facing ADR tools ship from parrot_tools.wiki.decisions
GraphIndex L2 budgeted, attributable retrieval and digest-based invalidation — the `source: graphindex, mode: retrieval` target
OKF v0.1 bundle shape (frontmatter type/title/id/tags) — export-only boundary; authored Tier-1 bundles would be the read-back direction
DocumentKB-shaped card: book_id, source_sha256, toc_digest, topics (filter key), scope project|global
card with source_sha256 as citation identity, revision, stale_fields — the richer digest/invalidation precedent
agent-facing wiki tools (wiki_*), scoped by wiki_name namespace, no tag filter
crew manifest (extra=forbid): agents list + execution_mode sequential|parallel|flow|loop; no lead/support role, no hub-and-spoke/mob
class_resolver / tool_resolver injection seam for an expert resolver
declarative topology: NodeDefinition(id, type) + EdgeDefinition with CEL predicates; no stage vocabulary (lead/support/inputs/outputs/gate)
AHP TTL gates with on_expiry fail|approve and payload_ref; GateKind/NodeId are closed dev-loop Literals
channel-facing HITL half (separate from dev_loop gates), stable for 90 days
the delegation tool to deny per expert; registered name `spawn_sub_agent`; allowlist only, no nesting guard
PBAC policy denial path — the existing deny mechanism with audit
ContextVar attribution; an inline expert needs an agent_identity() scope; seat is a free string, no tier attribute
only two-level model-tier precedent; file is off-limits per CONTEXT.md
per-model window → ContextBudget; reusable base for KnowledgeContext.budget_tokens
one of four bundled versioned domain ontologies (contracts, legal, procedures, field_services) — existing Tier-1 domain artifact and a naming collision for 'domain'
structured Graph as source of truth, Mermaid as derived view — pattern for ComponentCatalogue
hand-built domain expert with a code-level release gate (UngatedAnswerRefused) — primary migration candidate
second migration candidate; passes system_prompt verbatim (opts out of composable layers)
operational precedent for blind, advisory, read-only contributions (CONFIRM/REJECT/ESCALATE triage)
no subagent delegation seam today; expert delegation is a new section (plus host twins)

constraints.statement: The prompt identity is a single replace-by-name slot and configure() destroys templates; per-activation persona swaps must clone a pristine builder (IdentityMixin pattern).
constraints.implication: two inline experts cannot both occupy `identity`; a second named layer (e.g. expert_identity at a distinct priority) or a composition rule is required.

constraints.statement: FEAT-321 (approved) explicitly rejected a sectioned single-file persona in favour of five per-field identity files.
constraints.implication: the source's four-section persona.md contradicts an approved spec; adopt the identity/ layout or justify a supersede.

constraints.statement: User-authored prompt text is injected as PromptLayer(literal=True) (FEAT-707).
constraints.implication: persona, rules and knowledge layers must be literal (never `$`-substituted).

constraints.statement: registry.py is under active change (15 commits in 4 days, FEAT-746/747 review fixes on 2026-10-30) and duplicate names warn rather than fail.
constraints.implication: branch expert discovery after FEAT-746/747 settle; 'duplicate experts fail on load' is a stricter rule than the registry's.

constraints.statement: Tool gating is allowlist-shaped (allowed_tools on Agent/MCP/spawn) plus PBAC policy denial; no deny-list field exists and the delegation tool is registered as `spawn_sub_agent`.
constraints.implication: `tools_deny` is either a new field or expressed as an allowlist/PBAC rule; the invariant must name `spawn_sub_agent`.

constraints.statement: AHP gates (ApprovalGate, TTL fail-closed/fail-open) are typed to the dev-loop (closed GateKind/NodeId Literals); parrot/human HITL models are a separate mechanism.
constraints.implication: a stage gate must widen the Literals, lift the gate into flows/core, or build on parrot/human; two gate stacks must not become three.

constraints.statement: CrewDefinition/AgentDefinition are extra=forbid with no lead/support role and no hub-and-spoke or mob execution mode.
constraints.implication: subagent/mob dispatch is new orchestration on top of `parallel` + a lead integration step, not a config flag.

constraints.statement: ADR records carry source_status and review_status but no tags; reads are LLM-free and token-budgeted (budget_tokens).
constraints.implication: `filter: {status: [accepted]}` is directly supported; a domain/tag filter needs wiki tags or links to component pages.

constraints.statement: Agent-facing wiki access scopes by wiki_name namespace (LLMWikiToolkit.query has no tag parameter); the bookstore filter key is `topics`.
constraints.implication: `scope: {tags: [...]}` maps to a per-expert wiki namespace or a new tag filter in parrot_tools, and to `topics` on the bookstore.

constraints.statement: parrot/clients/base.py must not be modified (CONTEXT.md) and holds the only model-tier precedent (_lightweight_model).
constraints.implication: tier → model/effort projection lives at manifest load (BotConfig.model) or in flow seats, never in the client.

constraints.statement: Agent-facing toolkits (wiki, decisions, graphindex) ship from ai-parrot-tools; core keeps shims.
constraints.implication: the mandatory wikitoolkit/bookstore/graphindex access is a parrot_tools dependency of the expert runtime.

constraints.statement: The current KB path is retrieval-shaped (search per question) and dormant; inline always-present layers have no KB equivalent.
constraints.implication: a KnowledgeResolver owns inline layers via the prompt stack; replacing the KB search path is a separate, riskier change.

constraints.statement: RESERVED_TENANT_NAMES already reserves kb, documents, prompts, flows under an agent root; `.parrot/` is only used for crew_wiki.
constraints.implication: new directory names (experts/, knowledge/) must be checked against the reserved set; AGENTS_DIR is the precedent root.

constraints.statement: ContractsAgent routes every answer through a code-level release gate that raises UngatedAnswerRefused.
constraints.implication: a declarative bundle cannot express that gate; migration must keep code hooks (toolkit + answer service) beside persona/knowledge files.

constraints.statement: Subagent personas for the dev-flow are shipped as data files in four hand-synced copies (_subagent_data + .claude/.agent/.agents).
constraints.implication: delegation from sdd-spec/sdd-proposal must be added to the command and its host twins; a single-source bundle would reduce that drift.

new.role: validates expert.yaml (name==dir, mandatory wiki source, mandatory spawn_sub_agent deny, tier) and discovers bundles by presence, modelled on SkillsDirectoryLoader/parse_skill_directory and SkillView shadowing

pure, deterministic, ordered and token-budgeted layer resolution (rules → tier-1 shared → tier-1 expert → tier-2 shared → tier-2 expert → accepted ADRs → stage inputs → retrieval handles) rendered into the KNOWLEDGE_LAYER as a literal layer
additive ALWAYS/NEVER layers org → team → project → expert → stage; no precedent exists in memory or prompts
a NODE_REGISTRY node whose config carries lead/support/mode/inputs/outputs(schema)/gate, compiled into a FlowDefinition; validation fails on unknown expert or schema-less artifact
contributions/<slug>.md identity-marked artifacts, lead integration, gate that requires all contributions; codifies the sdd-secondopinion brief
agent_identity(expert) + usage_attribution(run, '<stage>.<expert>') around each activation so OTEL attributes the expert, not the conductor

modified.change: discover expert bundles (new kind or sibling loader feeding the registry), strict duplicate handling for experts, tag index for inert experts
accept an explicit identity_dir from a bundle (today derived from the class module) and expose the pristine-clone swap for per-activation personas
a named expert-identity/rules layer at a distinct priority if stacking over the conductor identity is chosen
class_resolver/tool_resolver that resolves an expert name to a configured agent
widen the closed Literals (or lift the gate into a generic host) to add approve_or_request_changes for stages
tag/topics scoping or per-expert namespace binding for the mandatory wiki source
new delegation section for validate/write/review capabilities

untouched: AbstractBot KB search path (register_kb / KBSelector) — kept as the retrieval-shaped KB in phase 1; the resolver owns inline layers only [F003, F004]
parrot/human models and channels — reused, not redesigned [F017, F039]
GraphIndex L2 internals and bookstore ingestion — consumed through RetrievalRequest/BookCard, not changed [F044, F027]
Observability plumbing — scopes are added, no new ContextVars except optionally a tier attribute [F021]
CVE feed ingestion, admin UI, multi-team mode — out of scope per the source
patterns_to_follow: Composite bundle discovery + frontmatter validation + token_count + assets_dir (skills) [F007, F008]
SkillView tenant-over-global shadowing with global_only locks for Tier-2-over-Tier-1 [F008, F034]
IdentityMixin pristine clone + mtime hot reload for persona swaps [F002]
FlowDefinition nodes by type from NODE_REGISTRY + CEL-conditioned edges for the scope grid [F015]
ApprovalGate on_expiry fail|approve with payload_ref pointing at contributions [F016]
DecisionService.why/for_symbol with budget_tokens; produced ADRs follow origin=inferred + review_status gate [F043, F009]
RetrievalRequest/RetrievalBudget → ContextBundle and SourceDigest invalidation for retrieval-mode sources [F044]
BookCard source_sha256 + topics + scope project|global as the DocumentKB contract [F027, F012]
sdd-secondopinion neutral brief for blind review contributions [F025]
Agent-facing tools in parrot_tools, shims in core [F010]

integration_risks.risk: Registry churn: FEAT-746/747 fixes still landing on registry.py
integration_risks.mitigation: branch after they settle; keep expert discovery a sibling loader

integration_risks.risk: Identity contract conflict with approved FEAT-321 (persona.md sections rejected)
integration_risks.mitigation: adopt identity/ five-file layout, or author a supersede ADR

integration_risks.risk: Two gate mechanisms (dev_loop ApprovalGate vs parrot/human) with closed Literals
integration_risks.impact: a third gate stack or tight coupling to dev_loop

integration_risks.risk: No deny-list; `tools_deny` naming does not match the real tool name
integration_risks.mitigation: express as allowlist/PBAC rule naming spawn_sub_agent; add a nesting guard

integration_risks.risk: Wiki scoping is by namespace, not tags
integration_risks.mitigation: per-expert wiki namespace first; tag filter later in parrot_tools

integration_risks.risk: Vocabulary collisions: 'domain' (ontology domains) and 'tier' (HITL escalation tiers)
integration_risks.mitigation: name the manifest field e.g. `judgement` or `model_class`; avoid 'domain' in module names

integration_risks.risk: Contracts migration cannot be purely declarative
integration_risks.impact: a 'migration proves the contract' goal fails
integration_risks.mitigation: bundle = persona + knowledge + rules; code hooks remain for toolkit and answer gate

integration_risks.risk: Four hand-synced copies of commands/agent briefs
integration_risks.mitigation: generate twins from one source or keep the protocol in a shared data file

integration_risks.risk: Scope breadth (5 phases) in one feature
integration_risks.mitigation: spec phases 1–2 as FEAT-778; stage/dispatch/scope grid as a follow-up spec

unknowns.question: Persona contract: adopt the approved FEAT-321 identity/ layout (role/goal/capabilities/backstory/rationale files) for the expert persona, or add a parser for the AI-DLC four-section persona.md that FEAT-321 rejected?
plausible_answers: reuse identity/ five files (no new parser, consistent with FEAT-321)
persona.md with the four AI-DLC sections, superseding FEAT-321's rejection via an ADR
both: identity/ for the prompt layer, persona.md kept as human-readable documentation only
unknowns.user_answer: Both — identity/ five files feed the prompt layer; persona.md is kept as human-readable documentation only

unknowns.question: Where do expert bundles live? AGENTS_DIR/experts/<slug> with tenant shadowing (skills precedent), package-bundled experts in ai-parrot-tools with a workspace overlay, or a new .parrot/experts root as in the source?
plausible_answers: package-bundled Tier 1 in ai-parrot-tools + AGENTS_DIR overlay for Tier 2
unknowns.user_answer: AGENTS_DIR/experts/<slug> — workspace bundles beside agents; Tier 2 via tenants/<t>/experts shadowing, same rules as skills (global_only locks)

unknowns.question: Registry integration: is an expert a BotConfig with a new AgentKind.EXPERT, a sibling ExpertManifest/ExpertRegistry that feeds AgentRegistry, or a DomainExpert Agent subclass?
plausible_answers: AgentKind.EXPERT on BotConfig (one registry, one YAML format)
sibling ExpertRegistry + ExpertManifest feeding AgentRegistry (decoupled from FEAT-746 churn)
DomainExpert(Agent) subclass configured from the bundle
unknowns.user_answer: Sibling ExpertManifest + ExpertRegistry — own Pydantic manifest and loader that registers a configured agent into AgentRegistry; decoupled from the FEAT-746/747 churn; strict duplicate rule stays local

unknowns.question: Stage gates: widen dev_loop's GateKind/NodeId Literals, lift ApprovalGate into a generic flows/core host, or build stage gates on parrot/human HumanInteraction?
plausible_answers: lift ApprovalGate into flows/core (generic host, dev_loop becomes a consumer)
widen the dev_loop Literals (fastest, couples experts to dev_loop)
unknowns.user_answer: Lift ApprovalGate into flows/core — generic gate host with open GateKind; dev_loop becomes a consumer

unknowns.question: Phase-1 blast radius: does the KnowledgeResolver replace AbstractBot's KB search path (as the source says) or coexist with it, owning only the inline layers?
plausible_answers: coexist: resolver owns inline layers, KB path untouched in phase 1
replace: KB path becomes a retrieval source of the resolver in phase 1
replace later: coexist in phase 1, fold KB in a dedicated follow-up
unknowns.user_answer: Replace in phase 1 — the KB path becomes a `mode: retrieval` source of the resolver now (higher blast radius in abstract.py accepted)

recommended_next_command.rationale: Localization is high-confidence and the five open forks are decisions, not research gaps; after Phase-5 answers, spec FEAT-778 as phases 1–2 (manifest + loader + resolver + persona layer + rules/ADR/wiki) and route the stage/dispatch/scope-grid layer (phases 3–4) to its own brainstorm.
